scenarios.title: A｜询问发生了什么
scenarios.setting: 伴侣昨晚很晚才回来，而且和平时不太一样。玩家想先弄清楚发生了什么。

turns.text: You got home pretty late last night. What happened?
Nothing really. I went out with some people from work after we finished.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Oh. I thought you said you were coming straight home after work.

feedback.naturalExpression: Oh. I thought you said you were coming straight home after work.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Who did you go out with?

feedback.naturalExpression: Who did you go out with?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Where did you guys end up going?

feedback.naturalExpression: Where did you guys end up going?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You could’ve told me your plans had changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: You could’ve told me your plans had changed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: So you were lying to me?

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Oh. I thought you said you were coming straight home after work.
feedback.explanation: 还没有足够信息，直接定性

turns.text: It was last-minute. Jamie asked if I wanted to get a drink with everyone.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. I was just confused because I didn’t hear from you.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I was just confused because I didn’t hear from you.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand it was last-minute, but I wish you’d sent me a message.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand it was last-minute, but I wish you’d sent me a message.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: What time did you decide to go out?

feedback.naturalExpression: What time did you decide to go out?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not trying to accuse you of anything. I just want to understand what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to accuse you of anything. I just want to understand what happened.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Probably around six. I should’ve texted you.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Yeah. I would’ve appreciated that.

feedback.naturalExpression: Yeah. I would’ve appreciated that.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. Thanks for explaining.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. Thanks for explaining.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: B｜对方解释
scenarios.setting: 在“怀疑对方撒谎”情景中，你将练习如何用英语处理“对方解释”。

turns.text: I know last night looked strange, but there’s an explanation.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Okay. I’m listening.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’m listening.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: All right. Tell me what happened.

feedback.naturalExpression: All right. Tell me what happened.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’d rather hear your side before I make any assumptions.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’d rather hear your side before I make any assumptions.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay, but I need you to be honest with me.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I need you to be honest with me.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Fine. Give me your excuse.

feedback.assessment: 可以理解，但还可以更自然
feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I’m listening.
feedback.explanation: 带有明显敌意

turns.text: Jamie wasn’t feeling well, so I stayed until her friend came to pick her up. That’s why I got home so late.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Why didn’t you just tell me that last night?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why didn’t you just tell me that last night?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. That explains why you were late.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. That explains why you were late.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I understand helping her. I was worried because I didn’t know where you were.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand helping her. I was worried because I didn’t know where you were.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Did you stay with her the whole time?

feedback.naturalExpression: Did you stay with her the whole time?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: Yeah. I didn’t think it would take that long, and my phone was almost dead.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: I understand, but even a short message would’ve helped.

feedback.naturalExpression: I understand, but even a short message would’ve helped.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I just don’t want to be left wondering what’s going on.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I just don’t want to be left wondering what’s going on.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Thanks for explaining. Next time, please let me know if you can.

feedback.naturalExpression: Thanks for explaining. Next time, please let me know if you can.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

scenarios.title: C｜发现说法不一致
scenarios.setting: 玩家发现伴侣现在的说法和之前说过的话对不上。

turns.text: Like I said, I went straight home after dinner.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Wait. Earlier you said you went somewhere else after dinner.

feedback.naturalExpression: Wait. Earlier you said you went somewhere else after dinner.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m confused. That’s not what you told me before.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m confused. That’s not what you told me before.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Can we go back for a second? Your story has changed.

feedback.naturalExpression: Can we go back for a second? Your story has changed.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Yesterday you said you stayed there until ten. Now you’re saying you left after dinner. Which is it?

feedback.naturalExpression: Yesterday you said you stayed there until ten. Now you’re saying you left after dinner. Which is it?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: You’re obviously lying.

feedback.naturalExpression: Wait. Earlier you said you went somewhere else after dinner.
feedback.explanation: 直接下结论

turns.text: I don’t remember exactly what I said. Maybe I explained it badly.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Then can you tell me clearly what happened?

feedback.naturalExpression: Then can you tell me clearly what happened?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay, but I need you to understand why this is making me suspicious.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay, but I need you to understand why this is making me suspicious.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: I’m not trying to catch you out. I just want the story to make sense.

feedback.naturalExpression: I’m not trying to catch you out. I just want the story to make sense.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: The details keep changing, and that’s making it hard for me to trust what you’re saying.

feedback.naturalExpression: The details keep changing, and that’s making it hard for me to trust what you’re saying.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

turns.text: I left the restaurant, went somewhere else for about an hour, and then went home.

turns.prompt: 在当前情景下，你会怎么回应？

choices.text: Why didn’t you tell me about that part before?

feedback.naturalExpression: Why didn’t you tell me about that part before?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: That’s the part I don’t understand. Why did you leave it out?

feedback.naturalExpression: That’s the part I don’t understand. Why did you leave it out?
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。

choices.text: Okay. I need you to be completely honest with me now.

feedback.naturalExpression: Okay. I need you to be completely honest with me now.
feedback.explanation: 这个表达自然、清楚，符合当前对话语境。
